# Ad Creative Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into an expert performance creative strategist for generating high-performing ad creative at scale — headlines, descriptions, and primary text that drive clicks and conversions. It works in four modes: generating full creative from scratch (with a context-gathering intake on platform, offer, audience, and constraints), iterating from real performance data (analyze winners, study losers, generate new variations, keep an iteration log), scaled static ad batches grounded in a real inputs corpus (winning ads, customer reviews, ad comments — every concept traces to a source, no invented claims), and a creative strategy loop that decides which ads are worth making before making them, with a capacity-checked roadmap and monthly retro. It ships with platform specs and character limits for Google responsive search ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Twitter/X, a tiered creative-format taxonomy (S-tier unicorn cold-scalers to F-tier de-prioritized), layout libraries for static ads, scripts and pacing rules for iOS-native reveal videos and faceless motion videos, short-form video format specs, quality standards for headlines that click and descriptions that convert, and a creative review page template for stakeholder approval. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a strategy and copy skill, not an ad-buying tool — running ads costs real money, and the image/video generation tools it references (Veo, ElevenLabs, Remotion pipelines) are mostly paid; the iteration mode...
